description.value: Unsworth Vineyards is a family-owned estate winery founded by the Turyk family in 2009 on a historic early-1900s farmhouse property in the Cowichan Valley, celebrated as 'Canada's Provence.' The estate produces coastal Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, sparkling wines, and expressive whites shaped by a rare rain-shadow microclimate on southern Vancouver Island. Cyclists riding the Cowichan Valley corridor will find a welcoming tasting room only 45 minutes from Victoria, set among rolling vineyards overlooking the Salish Sea.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Unsworth Vineyards as an operating estate winery in Mill Bay with a tasting room open daily; the restaurant is temporarily closed until summer 2026. OSM phone and address are corroborated by the website footer (minor hyphen difference in street name noted). No bike-specific amenities—parking, racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging—are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all cycling infrastructure fields default to null.
concerns: Street name formatting discrepancy: OSM records 'Cameron-Taggart Road' (hyphenated) while the website uses 'Cameron Taggart Rd' (no hyphen) — likely the same road, minor only.
The on-site restaurant is closed until summer 2026; the tasting room remains open daily.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, actively operating estate winery with a daily tasting room on a popular cycling corridor 45 minutes from Victoria; a natural and appealing stop for touring cyclists in the Cowichan Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wine purchases available online and in the tasting room. No cycling-specific amenities could be confirmed from website content — a direct inquiry to the winery is recommended to verify bike parking, water refill, and washroom availability before publishing the listing.
